title: deyeuxia cylindrica
intro: Deyeuxia cylindrica, commonly known as Chinese hair grass, is a type of grass native to China. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve congestion and reduce pain. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
